text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock A and E for gains, which felt satisfying, but a gain versus my cost basis alone is not a reason to sell; I should weigh each holding's future risk and return.","I should judge the portfolio as a whole, not treat each stock as a separate account. Realized gains on some positions do not erase losses or risk elsewhere.","Recent price moves do not predict future returns, so I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations and make disciplined decisions based on diversification and my investment plan."]}
